entities.name: PMID:25073934
observations: Five-year retrospective longitudinal study of 359 people with type 2 diabetes who had fundus photography at baseline and five years, with serial HbA1c and glycated-albumin measurements.
Mean glycated albumin was higher in the retinopathy-progression group than the non-progression group (22.66±5.92 vs 19.83±5.18; P<0.01).

Multivariable logistic regression found mean glycated albumin independently associated with retinopathy progression (OR 1.087, P=0.039), alongside mean HbA1c, baseline retinopathy status, and eGFR; reported cutoff was 21.85%.
Evidence is observational and retrospective; the abstract supports association and prediction within this cohort, not causal or externally validated predictive utility.
